answer: The meadow test I would run is Bestowed optometrist licence with optical council attestation: a licence the council renews after clinic audits, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. What the farm fears is not one hard check but a check that cannot be shared: a licence the council renews after clinic audits is per-account by construction, and the walnut is that the tenth clone costs as much as the first. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The summit grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
